name: flower-bloom.lua
title: Flower Bloom
description:
Flowers bloom in a random order, gently sway, and transform into the
original text. In the outro, the letters return to flowers before
disappearing together.
author: Mug

name: loop-flyby-and-sparkle-reentry.lua
title: Loop Flyby and Sparkle Reentry
description:
Characters loop in from the right, exit left, then re-enter from the distance with
a sparkle before fading out to the left.
author: Mug
